name: Rapunzel
source:
Initial Class: Pierrot

The youngest of the girls who has very long blond hair. At first, she mistakes [url=/c57596]Jack[/url] as the emergency rations and attempts to gnaw him, but as he cares for her by feeding and playing with her, they gradually become attached to one another.

Rapunzel likes to sleep on [url=/c57582]Nemurihime’s[/url] chest and is often witnessed napping with her.
